preconditions.description: The number of arguments n must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(a in {0, 1} for a in a_list)
preconditions.description: All elements in the list of arguments must be either 0 or 1.
The length of the list of arguments must be equal to n.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'NO' if not possible else stdout.startswith('YES')
postconditions.description: If it is impossible to arrange brackets to make the expression false, output 'NO'; otherwise, output 'YES' followed by the expression.
The total number of logical arguments in the output expression must equal n.
The number of implications in the output expression must be n - 1.
